test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Where is the headquarters of Oil and Natural Gas Corporation located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vasant Kunj **in **Delhi **serves as **ONGC's corporate headquarters**.
 
• **Shashi Shanker **is the **CEO of ONGC**.
 
• **Digboi **was the **first oil **to be **found in India**.
 
• In the **Andhra Pradesh **city of **Tatipaka**, **ONGC has a refinery**.
 
• A **division of ONGC is Mangalore Refineries **and **Petrochemicals Ltd**.
 
• **Operating Mumbai High Oil Field is ONGC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ONGC Videsh Limited **is an **Indian government-owned **Miniratna Schedule "**A" Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) **that reports to the **Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas**.
 
• It is the **main national oil firm **(NOC) **of India**, **Oil **and **Natural Gas Corporation Limited **(ONGC), and **its foreign affiliate**.
 
• It is **a shareholder in 37 oil **and **gas properties in 17 nations**.
